title: Axiocairn file-object receipt bundle: intent.json

tool.description: Canonical JSON array of adapter name and original loopback server URL

payload.description: Canonical JSON object with object=id, sha256=64 lowercase hex digits and size=nonnegative integer

$comment: report.json must match id/version/tool/payload exactly and state must be COMPLETED. object.bin is the independent GET snapshot; size and SHA-256 must match payload. Unresolved reports never verify successfully. This is consistency verification, not origin authentication.
